h: Soludo reportedly rules out automatic Anambra backing for Peter Obi in 2027
p: Anambra Governor Charles Soludo has reportedly said the state will not back Peter Obi by default in the 2027 presidential race. He is said to have argued that the 2027 contest will not be a repeat of 2023.
more: The remark adds to the debate over how Obi will fare in his home region.
Obi supporters have previously said he does not need any coalition to win.
